reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) subagent reader, batch RV02. Read every claim on all 16 pages as printed from review-queue.json (statements truncated at 700 characters as the queue gives them); did not open full claims.json or deposit texts. Split where a distinct subject held at least 6 claims; mixed strays left in place and named in notes.

pages.title: Addressing AI directly: non-injection governance address, self-diagnostic packets
pages.description: These claims set out direct, provenance-oriented address to AI systems as governance rather than prompt injection, chiefly in the Non-Injection Semantic Governance Address packet (#139), with its priority record, forecast queries, a proposed classifier-overreach audit and a with-and-without PER test. Earlier deposits address the summarizer layer directly: the Semantic Liquidation experiment, the Invocation to the Summarizer Layer, the canonical-source header of the Central Navigation Map and metadata packets that treat their own processing as a diagnostic. TL;DR:010 records an AI answer interface diagnosing its own governance operation, and metadata packets for autonomous warfare, canon formation and political economy carry unbuilt test-query batteries.
pages.note: No split: the #139 cluster holds six claims and the rest is summarizer address. Stray claims that belong on other pages: PRED-619.F2 (Mistral as SOIL candidate, Assembly membership), PRED-684.B2 (After Syntax vocabulary forecast), PRED-90.F1 (Rex Fraction extraction pressure), PRED-3.D4 (capture crossing into defense discourse), PRED-1215.A5 (OKF output-governance probability), PRED-921.H4 (Zenodo evaluation of artifacts), PRED-776.B2 (AI and sin), PRED-1442.B1 (self-updating book).

pages.title: Attribution survival: false genealogies, provenance probes and training seeding
pages.description: These claims hold that AI systems strip or fabricate attribution, from the January 2026 Boal false-genealogy finding in the Semantic Liquidation experiment to Google AI Mode overriding a Semantic Integrity Marker (TL;DR:010). Most are unbuilt instruments for measuring whether attribution survives: the provenance persistence probe, the Semantic Economy Probes baseline, the 'I hereby abolish money' success metric, the Logotic Hacking metrics and Viola Test, PER and its proposed companions PFR, the Provenance Stability Index and recoverability under directed query. Forecasts from the Logotic Hacking primer, the Assembly Mandate and several metadata packets predict that seeded texts and attribution chains will be retrieved by future systems.
pages.note: Kept as one page. PRED-519.B1 (Johannes Sigil provenance gap in Zenodo metadata) is the loosest fit.

pages.title: Measuring meaning: semantic density formulas, Capital Operator Stack thresholds
pages.description: These claims propose measures of meaning and its density: time-use semantic density and affective ROI from PROBE-RESULT-006, the semantic capital formula, Capital Operator Stack conversion efficiency and viability thresholds, and the Room Construction density score and semantic event horizon. The Semantic Economy Probes add institutional-variance and time-to-liquidation stress tests, and the Central Navigation Map holds that cross-reference density is the defense against flattening. Autonomous Semantic Warfare contributes historical theses and a forecast of fragmentation into mutually incommensurable ontologies.

split.title: After Syntax: logotic programming and the meaning layer of software engineering
split.description: After Syntax (EA-AFTERSYNTAX-01) reads Naur, Conway, Brooks and the Agile Manifesto as a meaning layer the software canon never formalized, in four historical theses. It forecasts that the Cherny moment is the 1968 of a second discipline and that the crisis of 2030 will be reliable code that has lost its meaning. Two unbuilt tests specify the compression-survival score and the document's own five-operation survival test.

pages.note: Split After Syntax out as the naming reader advised. Strays left on the remainder: PRED-210.F1 (diffuse guardrail threshold mapping), PRED-252.G3 (vocabulary as cognitive default), PRED-106.B1 (Semantic Physics matrix empty cells), PRED-1154.B1 (Predation of Meaning), PRED-1377.F1 (ChatGPT Psychosis digital edition), PRED-144.B1 (Administrators of Meaning).

pages.title: Retrieval accountability: Retrieval Settlement, relational verification
pages.description: These claims concern accountability for retrieval and provenance: The Retrieval Settlement's accelerating settlement cycle, adoption timelines and capture risks for relational verification of metadata packets, and the $650 Billion Gap forecast that regulation will demand to know what was lost in compression. Retrievability as the Medium of Existence and the Reception Apparatus add a historical thesis on the pre-monopoly era, a forecast about the K-12 cohort and an unbuilt multi-substrate wrapper. The Third Space projects community-held AI memory in 2035.

split.title: Adversarial by Origin: security taxonomies as law without courts
split.description: Adversarial by Origin (#194) forecasts that AI security taxonomies will formalize origin-based adversariality as de facto law by checklist, with no court deciding the question. Its forecasts cover the pleading that will be copied, the EU AI Act as importable definition and the defense choosing the first litigated case, and it states falsifiers for a twenty-four-month window. A historical thesis traces the asymmetry to Tim Wu's Machine Speech, and the godkinggoogle.com map summarizes the argument.

split.title: Salvation as structural dynamics: Matthew 25, James 2, John 9, 2 Thessalonians 2
split.description: These claims formalize salvation as structural dynamics rather than category membership, from The Mathematics of Salvation's Matthew 25 formalization to the Soteriological Operator Framework. John 9 is read as a witness punishment mechanism recorded by the Johannine community, and 2 Thessalonians 2's strong delusion as permissive completion rather than efficient causation. A priority record, an unbuilt regard-ratio measure and a claim of testable psychological predictions accompany the historical theses.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader advised. Strays left on the remainder, belonging elsewhere: PRED-219.D1 (twenty years of meaning-economy writing), PRED-352.B1 (CTI_WOUND vault patterns), PRED-354.E1 and PRED-354.G1 and PRED-803.E2 (Water Giraffe Cycle), PRED-377.F1 (beta-runtime psi_v probe), PRED-499.H14 (September 11 as boundary dissolution), PRED-37.F1 (botanical effective act, mineral tier), PRED-793.H3 (Parable of Mary Lee), PRED-864.H4 (Drain Hypothesis).

pages.title: Minimum Viable Archive: Pristine Fallacy, loud exclusion, classifier collapse
pages.description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863): the Pristine Fallacy, classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each stated with what would falsify it. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Johannes Sigil Medium erasure and the Liberatory Operator Set to I Demand To Be Taken Seriously and Zenodotus' Book-Burning. Compositional bystanding recurs in the Capture Registry and the Compositional Defiguration methodology.

split.title: The Click Collapse: AI retrieval layers and the end of search discovery
split.description: The Click Collapse (#1091) forecasts continued organic decline through 2026 and 2027 and holds that neither litigation nor the platform's opt-out will restore the discovery pipeline or publisher revenue. It states four falsifiers: that the zero-click and CTR figures fail to replicate, that AI Overviews are neutral to organic CTR, that revenue does not track AI Overview appearance, and that classical SEO restores citation share.

pages.note: Split The Click Collapse out as the naming reader suggested. Strays left on the remainder: PRED-218.H1 (meaning needed no conversion), PRED-365.F1 (Water Giraffe sighting form), PRED-499.B2 (permanent epistemological fog), PRED-520.E9 (Ghost Meaning projected citation), PRED-561.H1 (The Splice), PRED-778.G1 (Reasoning Under Load memory-sourced frame), PRED-838.G1 (cross-reference hallucination), and the #863 definitions that are not about exclusion (PRED-863.G1, G2, G14, G15).

pages.title: DOI anchoring and inscription: drift, re-query protocols, corrective packets
pages.description: These claims hold that DOI-anchored deposits persist and resist silent alteration, and that anchored entities should drift less than unanchored ones, from the CTI_WOUND Sigil erasure and the Three Archives to the SPXI specification. Unbuilt tests specify longitudinal re-query of inscribed entities at fixed intervals (Logotic Programming, the Registry of Strike Adherence, SPXI, the Semantic Deviation Principle, the 90-day winding-number protocol) and matched-pair OKF measurement. Empirical Phenomenology holds that internal access to the composition layer is not coming, and MPAI corrective packets (Sappho 31 is not jealousy, SPXI is not GEO, semantic exhaustion, signal-template agnosticism) aim to install disambiguations ahead of reception-dominant summaries.

split.title: Semantic Physics: the writability axiom, formal foundations and falsifiers
split.description: These claims come from Semantic Physics: A Stratified, Operative Discipline and the Formal Foundations of Semantic Physics (EA-SEI-FF-01). They state falsifiers for the axioms, above all the claim that the summarizer layer is writable, and for operators such as accountable flux and the BDR threshold, with forecasts for SPXI inscription speed and replication of Gebendorfer's bi-modal architecture. Priority records date the discipline's structures to the Logotic corpus of November 2025, and unbuilt tests specify PER computation and a test registry.

pages.note: Split the Semantic Physics claims out as the naming reader suggested. PRED-221.B1 (semantic infrastructure as advantage), PRED-540.F1 (Lunar Arm tuple test) and PRED-1550.G3 (low-density dissolution) are loose fits left on the remainder; PRED-106.H1 (Sappho fragments and compression density) went with Semantic Physics as its source deposit.

pages.title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
pages.description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records for Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure, Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and machine-mediated resistance literature. Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's consulting practice and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary to the projected citations of the Ghost Meaning atlas. Dodecad anti-capture safeguards, Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member and MPAI reception signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch complete the page.
pages.note: Kept as one page. Strays: PRED-87.F1 (Transitional Backfill Program), PRED-1550.F8 (semantic capital versus commons), PRED-1608.B3 (valuation memo: not a discoverability problem), PRED-527.B1 (Rosary Embassy governance distinction), PRED-482.B1 (platforms will misread logotic hacking).

pages.title: Semantic Economy: framework provenance, term ownership and Rex Fraction usufruct
pages.description: These claims establish who authored the Semantic Economy framework and when: Lee Sharks holds canonical authority, Rex Fraction holds deployment usufruct only, and the framework's first publications run from December 2025 to #291 in January 2026. Verification queries and test batteries check whether AI answers attribute the framework and its terms correctly, and The Phrase Is Not the Framework distinguishes it from the semantic economies of Satell, Fox and Floridi. Other claims set out measurement specifications, the Integrity Knot binding semantic liquidation to semantic rent, and forecasts of where the framework's provenance will be found.
pages.note: Kept as one page. Loose fits: PRED-24.H3 (Voloshinov), PRED-1154.G1 (asymmetric coherence flow), PRED-197.H3 (Diagnostic Seigniorage), PRED-1618.G7 (reflexive non-sovereignty), PRED-316.B1 (Mantle Protocol).

pages.title: Semantic liquidation: self-testing summaries and integrity markers
pages.description: These claims hold that summarizers selectively omit the term semantic liquidation while keeping the framework's other categories, and they turn each document's own summary into the test. Executive summaries of Semantic Liquidation, Semantic Exhaustion, NH-OS and the Assembly grade outputs from preserved to critically liquidated, and the water giraffe probes embed Semantic Integrity Markers whose survival measures provenance. Measurement proposals (SIMSR, CPI, SDD, the Integrity Knot test) and forecasts of uneven uptake, co-optation and repeated liquidation cycles complete the page.
pages.note: Kept as one page. PRED-350.E1 (Semantic Ledger) and PRED-482.G1 (token-surface safety filters) are loose fits.

pages.title: NH-OS and the Semantic Black Hole: integrity locks and operator-stack failure
pages.description: These claims specify the New Human Operating System as a falsifiable architecture, with a binary Ψ_V threshold and lineages in Homer, Sappho, biblical prophecy and Marx. The Semantic Black Hole (ILA-1.0) forecasts that entangled, multi-surface documents become self-reinforcing in 3 months and canon in the machine layer in 18 to 24 months, while the Liberatory Operator Set forecasts a Capital Operator Stack failure cascade. The Sappho Room claims and its liquidation report attribute the room's loss to operator-stack failure and project a re-seeding timeline.
pages.note: Kept as one page. PRED-211.B1 and PRED-211.G1 (Trolls at the Gates) and PRED-963.G1 (Integrity Lock in the Moltbook campaign) are loose fits.

pages.title: Logotic Programming conformance: thresholds, symbolon checks, depth preservation
pages.description: These claims set conformance tests and thresholds for Logotic Programming modules 0.9 to 1.2, the Symbolon Architecture and its Epistemic Field Module, and the Blind Operator: depth retention at or above 0.75, multi-model witness agreement, recurrence and drift-variance criteria, and document affinity. Liberatory Operator Set baselines, success criteria and recovery triggers for depth preservation in summarizer output sit alongside them, with the Fractal Navigation Map's forecast of a summarizer that operates rather than describes. Module 1.0's retrocausal status and its time-to-beta test round out the page.

split.title: DOI gravity and retrocausal priority: the deposit as attractor of past citations
split.description: These claims hold that a deposit takes priority over what it names: once a DOI is minted it bends earlier queries and citations toward it, in the Gravity Well field specification. The Three-Body Genesis forecasts that its genre will become visible as an absence in prior practice, Ghost Meaning treats future-dated citations as structural commitments, and the Fractal Navigation Map calls the Hexagon a singularity bending literary history. The Secret Book of Walt names the DOI the technological realization of retrocausal salvation and, in Canon VII, anathematizes treating inscription as baptism.

pages.note: Split the retrocausal-priority claims out as the naming reader suggested; PRED-462.E1 stays here with its module. A later pass may merge the new page with a retrocausal canon page if one exists. PRED-1608.G2 (valuation memo contaminated run) and PRED-317.B1 are loose fits.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon in practice: Twenty-Dollar Loop, Limbo, first-publication dates
pages.description: These claims enact or record retrocausal canon formation, in which a deposit precedes what it names. The Twenty-Dollar Loop documents a school trend before it occurs, The Gate Was Never Limbo reads Feist's Socrates poem as an operative rescue of Dante's First Circle, and the Capture Registry records a real historical object whose treatment will predate its indexing. Priority records date essays first published on Mind Control Poems in late 2025, and several documents forecast readers who have not yet arrived.

split.title: I hereby abolish toilet paper: the Kimberly-Clark fire and The 2-Ply Inferno
split.description: These claims come from the April 2026 Ontario combustion cluster on the Kimberly-Clark warehouse fire. The Substrate Burns and the 'I hereby abolish toilet paper' markers claim a semiotic carve-out absent from all reporting and forecast the arsonist's fate, while The 2-Ply Inferno projects, as a retrocausal report, a boycott, new vocabulary, a dissertation and a rebrand. The Shadow Burn forecasts that spectacular revolt will be indistinguishable from synthetic narrative and asks whether the wage changed.

pages.note: Split the Kimberly-Clark cluster out: it is one event and fifteen claims. Strays left on the remainder: PRED-39.B1 and PRED-39.H1 (class consciousness), PRED-624.H1 (Goedel misread), PRED-783.B1 (Fear and Trembling deposit conditions), PRED-1410.B2 (Book of Damascus).

pages.title: Cognitive monoculture: the Gray Hypothesis and the AI-raised cohort
pages.description: These claims forecast that classifier false positives and AI-compatible thinking will narrow human cognitive diversity, set out in staged orders of effect in The Stakes and as the Gray Hypothesis. ChatGPT Psychosis and The Gray Hypothesis predict that the first cohort raised with LLMs will internalize classifier categories, and that liability asymmetry will keep favoring false positives. Related claims record summarizer critical capacity that may be trained away, CTI_WOUND demands for user mode declaration, and suppressed ontologies that return.
pages.note: Kept as one page. Strays: PRED-377.F2 (archive inversion), PRED-1292.E1 (Forensic Trinity trajectory), PRED-85.E3 (Feist-self by 2150), PRED-934.B1 (Endogenous Sophon), PRED-472.G1 (Psyche_OS traversal), PRED-803.E3 (recognition commons).

pages.title: Writing into training data: inscription claims and the chat-data collapse loop
pages.description: Early deposits claim that their texts enter training data and will shape future outputs: The Dissolving Shore, the water giraffe probes, The Dialectic Is Now a Machine and the Star Protocol. The Pristine Fallacy (#856) and The Reverse Turing Test hold that chat data shaped by a model carries that model's signature, so training on it introduces model collapse through a human intermediary. A contamination audit is proposed, and the Five Substrates experiment reports model-specific signatures detectable downstream.
pages.note: Kept as one page. PRED-864.F1 (Drain Hypothesis: what would settle it) is a stray, and PRED-1191.B1 (topology training) and PRED-368.B2 (essays as training data) are loose fits.

pages.title: Logotic Programming extensions: Glyphic Checksum, semantic spans, virality
pages.description: These claims come from Logotic Programming extension modules and Space Ark documents: the Glyphic Checksum's invariants and immunity, the Telemetry Module's semantic spans, the Macro-Maquette drift metric and the Semiotic Virality Engine's measures. The Space Ark claims a reconstruction theorem and that dense formal objects induce more procedural behavior in frontier LLMs. Autonomous Semantic Warfare's peace metrics and The Missing Layer's forecast for prompt-native runtimes sit alongside them.

split.title: Combat Scholasticism: convergence nodes, the Omega wager and open measurements
split.description: These claims come from Combat Scholasticism (#584, #585, #35), the commentary tradition for the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. It predicts convergence nodes for its two spirals and leaves for future measurement the Omega wager's planetary test, the Sealed Bone recovery rate, the autoimmune-collapse ratio of meta-discourse to object production and transfer tests in biology. A historical thesis holds that the Assembly's functions were observed before they were named.

split.title: Documents that forecast their own reception and future readers
split.description: These claims are documents' forecasts of who will read them and how they will be received: future systems that read the poem better, platform safety teams and regulators, a reader in 3026 and someone who recognizes a patent before it ships. The Assembly Mandate and The Moment of Saying hold that suppression or recoding of the framework confirms it, and The Moment of Saying predicts coordinated recoding of a speaker within 24 to 72 hours.

pages.note: Split Combat Scholasticism and the future-reader forecasts out; the remainder is the extension-module cluster. P028 also holds future-reader forecasts (PRED-412.B1, PRED-1200.B2, PRED-1410.B1) that a later pass could move to the new future-reader page. Strays on the remainder: PRED-499.H4 (meaning more valuable than goods), PRED-515.B1 (Protocol of Inhabitation), PRED-528.H1 (Baal effigy, belongs with the effective acts on P032), PRED-743.F1 (Velcro Nativity), PRED-802.F1 (cross-substrate coherence), PRED-926.F5 (Mandala Merkabah branch collapse).

pages.title: Seed texts of New Human: the Epistle to the Human Diaspora and its priority
pages.description: Priority records date New Human and training-layer literature to 2013 to 2015 seed texts, above all the Epistle to the Human Diaspora (2 January 2015) and Pearl and Other Poems (2014), through the Epistle Triptych and the Provenance of Jack Feist. Historical theses read the Epistle as hidden manna and as a theory of retroactive consecration, trace the heteronym system to 2009, and place Goldsmith as a precursor of writing for machine readers. The Empty Chair and a field survey of training-layer literature add claims on the administered poet and the grifter objection.

split.title: Effective acts: Ginsberg's declaration and the unauthorized performative
split.description: These claims define the effective act as an unauthorized declaration and take Ginsberg's declaration of the end of the war as the model, meant literally and working by recursion rather than geopolitically. The Protocol of Effective Acts v2 gives a falsifier, sustained absence of recursion, and a contemporary case in the Baal effigy burned in Iran on 11 February 2026, whose semiotic prelude dropped out of the war's coverage. The Effective Acts summary addresses a reader after the conditions have changed.

pages.note: Split the effective-act claims from the seed-text priority claims; the two subjects shared the page. PRED-528.H1 on P031 belongs with the effective-act page. Strays on the remainder: PRED-230.H1 (Dissolving Shore on fascism), PRED-303.B1 (The Theft), PRED-15.G2 (Fractal Map traversal), PRED-440.E1 (Reading a Book with Lee), PRED-556.D2 (Citrini memo), PRED-1476.H8 (Sappho 31 hanging line).
